PropheticSentinel.description: Adjacent friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style>. Adjacent friendly <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> have <style="Stat_Chance">+{[blockChance]}% Block chance</style> and block <style="Stat_Block">+{[blockDmg]} Damage</style>. At the end of its turn, if the <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Sekhetar Robot</style> is adjacent to a friendly Psyker, it starts <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, even if it attacked during its turn.
